news.title: Strategic Implications of Deploying Artificial Intelligence in Defence
news.summary_en: Examines strategic implications of AI in defence, analyzing how AI could shift the offence-defence balance, accelerate proliferation, empower non-state actors, and intensify great power competition.

news.title: Investigating the potential use of frontier AI models for offensive cyberattacks: A human uplift study
news.summary_en: The UK Artificial Intelligence Security Institute (UK AISI) commissioned RAND to conduct a human uplift study to evaluate the impact of AI access on offensive cyber operations among lower-skilled threat actors.
